test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Constitution (One Hundredth Amendment) Act, 2015 is related to ______.

options.text: Mutual transfer of certain territories between India and Sikkim
Mutual transfer of certain territories between India and China
Mutual transfer of certain territories between India and Bangladesh
Mutual transfer of certain territories between India and Nepal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mutual transfer of certain territories between India and Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Land Boundary Agreement between India and Bangladesh **was ratified by the **Constitution (100th Amendment) Act of 2015.**
 
• In accordance with the **1974 bilateral LBA, the legislation **revised the first schedule of the constitution to exchange the disputed regions occupied by both nations.
 
• On the Indian mainland, India acquired 51 Bangladeshi enclaves (containing 7,110 acres), whereas Bangladesh received 111 Indian enclaves (covering 17,160 acres).
 
• **The India-Bangladesh Agreement **was reached in 1974, but it was never ratified because it involved territory transfer, which necessitated a constitutional amendment.
 
• The Bill modifies the Constitution's First Schedule to give effect to an agreement between India and Bangladesh on the acquisition and transfer of lands between the two countries, which was signed on May 16, 1974.
 
• The area of each state and union territory that makes up India is defined in the First Schedule of the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Sino-Indian boundary dispute **is a long-running territorial dispute between China and India regarding the sovereignty of two relatively large and numerous smaller, isolated areas of land.
